Initial release of resume-story-spinr

- Converts weak resume bullets into quantified, STAR-method achievement statements.
- Scores resumes for ATS keyword coverage against job descriptions and flags weak or filler phrases.
- Expands each bullet into interview-ready STAR story scaffolding with likely follow-up questions.
- Provides metric hints for unquantified bullets and suggests strong verb replacements.
- Designed for resume writing, tailoring to job postings, and interview preparation.
